item.title: BATTLE RED: No. 12 Katy has balance at plate, on diamond
item.description: 12. Katy Tigers (6A)Katy reached the Regional Semifinals in 2025 after going 28-10 overall and winning District 19-6A. Wes Hearne should be ready to rock this year with senior shortstop Ashten Ballew returning after being a first-team, all-district pick a year ago. Ballew hit .316 at the plate with four homers and 20 stolen bases. item.title: BLACK AND GOLD: Can No. 11 Conroe build on breakout 2025?
item.description: 11. Conroe Tigers (6A)Conroe reached the Regional Semifinals a year ago and finished with a 23-11-1 overall record. Jeff Raymer enters his 13th season (133 wins) of leading the Tigers. Seven starters return for Conroe, including first-team, all-district outfielder Tanner Trantham (Blinn College) and first-team, all-district pitcher Owen Raymer (Cedar Valley).
